span.p:
① Prune dead channels
remove Disconnected entries
from channels HashMap
(SocketAddr → Channel)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
③ Schedule keepalives
Channel::keepalive_due(now)
if last_sent elapsed ≥
KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL_MS (1,000ms)
→ add addr to keepalives list
Note: caller must touch_sent

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Not done: fragment-reassembly sweep.
The SGW client has no periodic stale
sweep (spec §2.4.1 R13 + §2.10 S6).
Abandoned reassemblies are evicted only
when an overlapping bundle arrives (in
FragmentAssembler::add_fragment) or when
the channel itself is torn down.
